Drink plenty of water and contact your doctor for any worsening symptoms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"worsening"** means becoming worse or more severe. (बिगड़ता हुआ)

 
 
• **Example: **The patient's condition was **worsening **despite the medication.
 
 
 
• **"Contact"** refers to communicating with someone, typically in order to give or receive specific information. (संपर्क करना)
 
 
• **Example: **Please **contact **the customer service for further assistance.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the sentence is **grammatically correct and does not contain any errors.**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **for any worsening symptoms** (किसी भी बिगड़ते लक्षणों के लिए): This phrase is correct and does not contain any grammatical errors.

• **and contact your doctor** (और अपने डॉक्टर से संपर्क करें): This phrase is also correct and does not contain any grammatical errors.
